profile.headline: I do things at Google.
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Eric Duran is a Dominican American Software Engineer based out of NYC. He works at Google as a Senior Software Engineer. He previously worked at NBC & LearnVest as a Staff Software Engineer and Tech Lead. 

Eric is passionate about helping traditionally underrepresented communities succeed in Tech. He is currently Adjunct Instructor with Google's Tech Exchange academic program.

He is a highly motivated and results-oriented individual with a strong track record of success.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Lead Architect for re-platforming LearnVest consumer-facing web infrastructure using NodeJS, GoLang, GraphQL, React
- Managed our CI/CD pipeline using Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins
- Fun: Built a custom dynamic reverse proxy with Lua, Nginx, & Go to allow us to migrate our site based data from our API
- Provided mentoring & training for a team of diverse engineers

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / Tech Lead
positions.description:
- Lead Architect for new CMS & API Infrastructure (2015-2016)
- Lead Developer & Creator of Flo - NBCUniversal’s Continues Integration & Delivery platform. 
  - Provided deep Github API & Jenkins integration for Code Review, Code Quality, Unit Test, Quality Assurance, Code Coverage, and Deployments. (2014-2015)
- Tech lead for CMS Platform used by most of NBCUniversal’s Web Properties, including nbc, syfy, usa network, etc.. (2013-2015)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
- Lead Web Performance engineer for nbc.com, telemundo.com, syfy.com, msnbc.com, & bravotv.com (2013-2015)
- Internal Developer Advocate for Open Source Contributions

positions.title: Director of Engineering
positions.description: - Lead consultant for Comcast Interactive Media

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
- Lead Architect for http://video.pac-12.com
- Senior developer for Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, Inc (MSLO).
- Architected and Developed a Single Sign On solution across all of MSLO property with various social network providers such as Google, Facebook, Twitter (not publicly available yet).
- Architected an automated testing environment for testing PHP, JavaScript, Drupal, and coding syntax at MSLO.
- Developed and Architected various parts of www.marthastewart.com, http://www.wholeliving.com/, http://www.marthastewartweddings.com/ and other properties.
- Developed various JSON & XML services to interact with Mobile applications for drupalize.me
- Module development consulting.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
- Lead Engineer / Architect for the New York Stock Exchange.
- Migrated NYX Data (http://www.nyxdata.com/) to Drupal, while still keeping all the data in a custom C# CMS. Using a custom Drupal services module for wsdl services.
- Architected and Developed the NYSE new blogging platform for all blogs shared across 20 websites.
- Build a custom Drupal module that powers the NYSE Google gadget widgets, this module determines when the market is open/closed and Various of other details related to the NYSE.
- Architected the Global Navigation used throughout all the sites.
- Provided support and trained NYSE Engineers on Drupal module development and theming
system.
- Build numerous other modules to display NYSE alerts across multiple sites and external sources.
- Architected and Developed sharable feature that will live across multiple sites including Content Types, Views, and custom exportable modules.
- Architected a better Dev/Staging/QA process using Features, Strongarm, and Ctools.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developed/maintained multiple Drupal Websites
- Migrated The Journal of Commerce (http://www.joc.com) from a Custom CMS to Drupal (D6)
- Developed The Journal of Commerce Site & Theme
- Migrated Breakbulk Online (http://breakbulk.com) from Wordpress to Drupal (D6)
- Developed a custom authentication module for joc.com and breakbulk.com using XML-RPC
and an external data source
- Developed a new Drupal Site for Flanders House (http://www.flandershouse.org/) (D6)
- Developed and themed Leslie Greene Store (http://lesliegreenestore.com) (D6, Ubercart)
- Developed new modules for Burbia (http://www.burbia.com/) (D4.7)
- Developed numerous other sites built in a custom CMS
- Developed/maintained Numerous J2EE projects

positions.title: Accounts Payable Clerk
positions.description:
- 2+ years experience with Elite Enterprise
- Processed rush accounts payable and reimbursement checks
- Processed, coding and entry of different disbursements.
- Distribution and reconciliation of petty cash
- Research of A/P statements and response to vendor inquiries
- Kept contact and follow-up with attorneys regarding payment status
- Manage all invoices to be uploaded including Fed-Ex billing online, Seamless web, Messengers service, Car service, Westlaw, Lexis Nexis, and Pacer.
